using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Args;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands.Services;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Tests.Commands;

public class SuiteCommandTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ICmdHelper> _mockCmdHelper;
    private readonly Mock<AbpNuGetIndexUrlService> _mockNuGetIndexUrlService;
    private readonly Mock<PackageVersionCheckerService> _mockPackageVersionCheckerService;
    private readonly Mock<AuthService> _mockAuthService;
    private readonly Mock<CliHttpClientFactory> _mockCliHttpClientFactory;
    private readonly Mock<SuiteAppSettingsService> _mockSuiteAppSettingsService;
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<SuiteCommand>> _mockLogger;

    public SuiteCommandTests()
    {
        _mockCmdHelper = new Mock<ICmdHelper>();
        _mockNuGetIndexUrlService = new Mock<AbpNuGetIndexUrlService>();
        _mockPackageVersionCheckerService = new Mock<PackageVersionCheckerService>();
        _mockAuthService = new Mock<AuthService>();
        _mockCliHttpClientFactory = new Mock<CliHttpClientFactory>();
        _mockSuiteAppSettingsService = new Mock<SuiteAppSettingsService>();
        _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<SuiteCommand>>();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ShowSuiteManualInstallCommand_Should_Log_InstallCommand_Message()
    {
        // Arrange
        var command = CreateSuiteCommand();

        // Act
        command.ShowSuiteManualInstallCommand();

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                0,
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("dotnet tool install -g Volo.Abp.Suite --add-source https://nuget.abp.io/<your-private-key>/v3/index.json")),
                null,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task UpdateSuiteAsync_With_Version_Should_Log_UpdateMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        var command = CreateSuiteCommand();
        _mockNuGetIndexUrlService.Setup(x => x.GetAsync()).ReturnsAsync("https://nuget.abp.io/test/v3/index.json");

        // Act
        await command.UpdateSuiteAsync("1.0.0");

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                0,
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Updating ABP Suite to the 1.0.0...")),
                null,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task UpdateSuiteAsync_With_Preview_Should_Log_PreviewMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        var command = CreateSuiteCommand();
        _mockNuGetIndexUrlService.Setup(x => x.GetAsync()).ReturnsAsync("https://nuget.abp.io/test/v3/index.json");

        // Act
        await command.UpdateSuiteAsync(preview: true);

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                0,
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Updating ABP Suite to the latest preview version...")),
                null,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task UpdateSuiteAsync_Without_VersionOrPreview_Should_Log_DefaultMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        var command = CreateSuiteCommand();
        _mockNuGetIndexUrlService.Setup(x => x.GetAsync()).ReturnsAsync("https://nuget.abp.io/test/v3/index.json");

        // Act
        await command.UpdateSuiteAsync();

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                0,
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Updating ABP Suite ...")),
                null,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    private SuiteCommand CreateSuiteCommand()
    {
        var command = new SuiteCommand(
            _mockNuGetIndexUrlService.Object,
            _mockPackageVersionCheckerService.Object,
            _mockCmdHelper.Object,
            _mockAuthService.Object,
            _mockCliHttpClientFactory.Object,
            _mockSuiteAppSettingsService.Object);

        command.Logger = _mockLogger.Object;
        return command;
    }
}
